label: Get the Job — Advisory Pricing & Proposals
overview: The advisory pricing and proposal templates give the advisor a professional, defensible way to scope, price, and present advisory engagements. Three core tools cover the full spectrum: the Advisory Pricing Model for complex or team-based engagements, the General Advisory Proposal for bespoke consulting, and the Lite Fundamentals Proposal for foundational coaching programs. The Variation to Scope of Works document protects the advisor against scope creep once the engagement is underway.

diagnostic_entry.primary_question: What type of engagement are you pricing — is it a bespoke, custom consulting job, a foundational coaching program, a due diligence review, or has the client requested something outside the original scope?

support_tools.name: Advisory Pricing Model
support_tools.purpose: A comprehensive spreadsheet for calculating advisory fees across complex, multi-team engagements. Breaks the job into components (scoping, research, presentation, implementation) and applies staff-specific hourly rates to each. Includes a Due Diligence Scoping Model for mergers and acquisitions.
support_tools.core_principle: Every hour must be accounted for before the engagement begins. The model prevents scope creep by forcing the advisor to define what is chargeable upfront — not after the work is done.
support_tools.when_to_use: When the engagement involves multiple team members, a complex bespoke project, or a due diligence review. Not needed for simple foundational coaching programs.
key_benefits: Removes guesswork from pricing — pre-calculated bundled options and a Blank Team matrix speed up scoping
Protects firm profitability by separating chargeable discovery and research from non-chargeable proposal presentation time
Provides the client with complete transparency — they see exactly what they are paying for and why
The Due Diligence Scoping Model systematically covers structural, asset, and staff reviews for M&A work
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Enter staff names and their travel, prep, and advisory hourly rates into the Blank Team Pricing Matrix tab before using the calculation sheets. This is a one-time setup step — do it once, then reuse across engagements.

steps.name: Enter team rates
steps.guidance: Navigate to the Blank Team Pricing Matrix tab. Input each team member's name and their respective rates for travel, preparation, and advisory time.

steps.name: Break into components
steps.guidance: Divide the project into phases: Introduction, Scoping, Research, Presentation, Implementation, Review. Assign the appropriate team member to each phase and estimate the hours required.

steps.name: Flag chargeability
steps.guidance: Mark which phases are chargeable (typically discovery, research, and implementation) and which are not (typically proposal presentation). This distinction must be made before the engagement is priced.

support_tools.name: General Advisory Proposal
support_tools.purpose: A slide deck for converting discovery meeting findings into a compelling, structured pitch for bespoke advisory services. Connects the client's End Game to the specific actions required to get there.
support_tools.core_principle: The proposal must show the client not just what the advisor will do, but how many hours the client themselves must commit. Shared ownership of the process is established from day one.
support_tools.when_to_use: When the engagement is highly customised and tailored to the client's specific, unique business problems — typically after a Total Needs scoping session.
key_benefits: Structures the narrative around the client's own stated objectives and constraints — not a generic pitch
Lists the exact hours the client and their staff must commit, setting clear expectations upfront
Built-in Variation to Scope of Works template handles future out-of-scope requests professionally
Justifies the financial investment through a logical, evidence-based narrative
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: In the Recommendations section, the hours listed are strictly the client's time commitment — not the advisor's. Make this distinction explicit when presenting. Clients are often surprised by how much of their own time is required.

steps.name: List business objectives
steps.guidance: Document the client's stated End Game — what they want the business to achieve. Use their exact words from the discovery session.

steps.name: Identify legitimate constraints
steps.guidance: List what is currently holding them back from achieving those objectives. These are the problems the engagement will solve.

steps.name: Detail recommendations
steps.guidance: Outline the specific steps to address the constraints. Crucially, include the hours the client must commit to each step — not the advisor's hours.

steps.name: Set the financial investment
steps.guidance: Clearly state the monthly investment and total fee using the pricing model outputs.

steps.name: Handle out-of-scope requests
steps.guidance: Once signed, any new work requested must be documented in the Variation to Scope of Works — state the new issue, timeline, and additional estimated fee, and obtain signature before commencing.

support_tools.name: Lite Fundamentals Proposal
support_tools.purpose: A pre-packaged, auto-populated slide deck proposal for the foundational Lite Fundamentals advisory program. Positions the engagement around three pillars: Getting More Organised, Getting More Work, and Doing More Profitable Work.
support_tools.core_principle: Scalable and efficient. The merge table in the advisor portal auto-populates all proposal fields — the advisor enters data once and the document is generated. No writing from scratch.
support_tools.when_to_use: When the client is a smaller business needing foundational coaching and structured systems — not complex or bespoke. This is the standard entry point for most new Lite advisory engagements.
key_benefits: Out-of-the-box advisory program — ready to present without custom drafting
Merge table tool in the portal auto-populates all fields from a single data entry
Demystifies business growth for the client by framing it around three simple, digestible pillars
Appropriate for a wide range of client types — reduces the barrier to entry for newer advisors
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Navigate to the merge table in the advisor portal and enter the required data fields. The document populates automatically. When presenting, lead with the three pillars — Organised, More Work, Profitable Work — as the client's learning journey, not as a product.

support_tools.name: Variation to Scope of Works
support_tools.purpose: A formal document for capturing and agreeing new work that falls outside the original proposal. Prevents scope creep and protects the advisor's fee once the engagement is underway.
support_tools.when_to_use: Any time the client requests assistance with something not covered in the original proposal — including informal requests. Use immediately, before commencing the extra work.
key_benefits: Protects the firm's profitability by formalising all additional work before it begins
Prevents misunderstandings about what is and is not included in the original engagement
Maintains the professional standard of the engagement — clients respect clear boundaries
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Document the new issue, the timeline, and the estimated additional fee. Obtain the client's signature before starting. Never begin additional work on the basis of a verbal agreement, however casual the request appears.

advisor_guidance.chargeability: Discovery, scoping, and research are generally chargeable. Proposal presentation is generally not — but for highly complex engagements, the scoping meeting itself may warrant a charge.
advisor_guidance.scope_creep: The most common profitability leak in advisory work is scope creep. Use the Variation to Scope of Works document every single time without exception — not just for large requests.
advisor_guidance.proposal_choice: Bespoke client with unique problems: General Advisory Proposal. Smaller client needing foundational coaching: Lite Fundamentals Proposal. Merger or acquisition: Advisory Pricing Model with the Due Diligence Scoping tab.
